note: The private half of tests/data/replay_open_mutants.json (tools/mutate.py runs it together with the public half): the mutants of files that are not in the public repository, and the ones that only a test that is not there catches. Mutants of the page that opens a replay file of your own (docs/REPLAYS.md "A file of your own") for tools/mutate.py (docs/TESTING.md, 'Mutation checks'): web/replay_page.js (the size, the checksum, the hand-off, the strip, the card of a map that the game refuses, the header), web/matches.html, web/shell.html (the card, the wrapping of text that cannot wrap), web/map_files.js (the count of the starting ants of a carried map) and the constant of include/ants_replay/replay.hpp against tests/scripts/web_replay_open_check.js (node: the code on the real file, on every cut and every flipped bit of its head, on a fake IndexedDB and a fake page) and the static checks of tests/scripts/test_web_replay_open.py. Run from the checkout: python3 tools/mutate.py tests/data/replay_open_mutants.json --keep-going --jobs 1 --timeout 300. Every mutant must be caught; the same test file runs the list in the quick tier on a copy. Each `why` names what the mutant loses.
